improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by selecting an IR that emphasizes low-end punch and dark voicing suitable for aggressive, fuzzy bass-rock tones.

proposals.reason: The current 4x12 may be too bright; a smaller, darker cabinet will emphasize the required tight sub-bass and punch.
